ITEM 1 | Bright orange carrot slices and sticks, glossy with slight moisture, firm, cut into thick rounds and wedges about 1-2 cm wide and 4-6 cm long, some with browned edges, clustered at upper center of the bowl | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow squash or zucchini-like slices, fan-shaped, cut about 0.5 cm thick, soft-looking with slight translucency and light golden edges, lying on the left side of the bowl | 35
ITEM 3 | Green broccoli florets, bright to dark green, bumpy surface, firm, about 2-3 cm across each, three to four florets, one cluster sits at top center and another in the lower center | 45
ITEM 4 | Fresh dark green leafy greens with thin pale stems, ruffled edges, slightly glossy, loosely piled on the right side of the bowl, covering roughly a quarter of the bowl, about 3-4 cm tall | 40
ITEM 5 | Grain mixture with tan and golden grains, some orange and red bits, small green herb flecks, moist and clumpy, slightly glossy, mounded at lower center, about 5 cm across and 1.5 cm tall | 70
ITEM 6 | Small brown pieces of cooked meat or mushroom-like chunks mixed into the grain, matte, soft, about 1 cm each, scattered in the lower center | 10
